Showers And Tub Surrounds

Make your bathroom work better and look finished, with careful tile work from the layers underneath to the details you see every day.

A Solid Start And A Clean Finish

Bathroom projects can include a full tear-out, new waterproofing, and a carefully planned tile layout. Good tile is only as good as what is underneath it, so the preparation matters as much as the visible finish.

Every project has its own needs. We will talk through the existing space, your goals, and practical options before work begins.
